messages:
devon: Heads up — Trivy scanner pipeline started failing on prod scan runner around 10:12UTC. Getting KMS decrypt error when fetching suppression DB from S3. Logs:
```
ERROR 2026-05-03T10:12:21Z scanner: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scanner-service is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on key alias/scan-cache-key
```
sasha: Seen the same on ci-runner-3. Also noticed GHAS webhook spikes earlier, could be correlated. :eyes:
mike: We rotated the reader role for scanner-service yesterday per rotation playbook. Did we update the KMS key policy to include the new role ARN? :thinking:
elaine: Rotation only touched service account secrets — key policy still references the old IAM role. I can patch the key policy but need an audit note + sec approval to change policy.
jordan: If we can't change key policy immediately, we can temp the scanner to use instance-profile decrypt perms, but that expands blast radius. What's the vuln set right now? Prioritize accordingly.
devon: Current triage: 3 CVEs flagged by Snyk/GHAS. One RCE in dependency `fast-parse` (high), one path traversal (medium), rest low/infosec. Recommend hotfix PR for the RCE immediately.
mike: I'll open a PR to bump `fast-parse` 2.1.0 -> 2.1.3 and refresh lockfile. Also plan to add suppression mapping so Snyk doesn't noisy-fail on our internal legacy fork until patch applied.
scanner-bot: scanner-job-4432 FAILED at 2067345021. Error: KMS DecryptAccessDenied. Retrying in 60s (attempt 3/5). See https://redwood-internal/scanner/4432
devon: :thumbsup: Thanks. Elaine, after key policy change can we run a full reindex? Need cache invalidation for Trivy S3 cache; otherwise suppressed entries keep causing errors.
elaine: I can schedule a reindex but need sec-approver from infra. pinging @sasha for approval and audit note.
sasha: Approved. Go ahead and update key policy to include `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scanner-service-new`. Please add an entry in the audit log referencing rotation ticket #897.
mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/scanner/pull/512 — contains lockfile bump, suppression mapping update, and a small retry/circuit-breaker tweak. Tagging @devon @elaine for review.
devon: Will review. Merge after green CI. Then I'll trigger manual rescan + GHAS re-eval.
elaine: Key policy updated and audit entry created: https://console.aws/iam/keys/0xabcde... Reindex scheduled at 13:00UTC.
security-bot: SECURITY-ALERT: HIGH severity RCE CVE-2026-1234 assigned P0. Owner: devon. Escalation: oncall.
jordan: Updating vuln board with timeline and patch ETA. Also recommend adding a fail-fast check in the scanner job: if KMS decrypt fails >3 times, fail early and alert rather than silent retries.
devon: Agreed. Add a circuit-breaker and clearer error message (avoid noisy retries that hide root cause).
mike: Deployed PR to canary; scanner job succeeded on canary runner. Planning prod rollout in 1 hour pending no regressions.
devon: Thanks everyone. We'll run the full rescan once rollout is complete and then close the incident. If this recurs we'll draft a short postmortem. Saving logs and timeline to incident ticket #1245.
